SYMPTOM: No-show button clicked, DB not updated, Chrome console showed 'permission denied for table sessions'
CAUSE: mark-no-show.ts API route uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY but staging service role key lacks table-level grants on 'sessions'. Same issue previously seen with 'students' table inserts.
FIX: Replaced API call in Calendar.tsx no-show handler with direct Supabase client update using tutor's auth session (has RLS permission via auth.uid() = tutor_id). Email send moved outside try/catch so failure doesn't trigger false error alert.
PREVENT: Don't use API routes for simple DB updates in Tutlio — use Supabase client directly. Service role key is unreliable in staging/prod.
FILE: src/pages/Calendar.tsx — handleNoShow function
